name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Ordering & kitchen app for food trucks
promotionalText: Accept pre-orders, prevent orders beyond the kitchen's cooking capacity, and keep trading even when the signal drops. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering & kitchen app for food trucks. Your team runs service with this app.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Staff check every order on one screen, approve the orders the kitchen can cook, then set them to ready and collected.

[Don't promise a time you can't keep]
Set the amount you can cook at once and how long cooking takes. When a collection-time slot fills up, customers can no longer choose that time, so the order queue matches the kitchen's cooking capacity.

[Take orders at the counter too]
You can add counter (walk-up) orders to the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen cooks along a single queue.

[One screen for the kitchen]
The kitchen display shows what to make now, what to make next and what is ready, and alerts you when there is an order you should start cooking.

[Print order tickets]
Connect the kitchen receipt printer by Bluetooth or local network and order tickets print automatically.

[Keep trading even when the signal drops]
If you switch on offline order protection, accepting pre-orders pauses when the connection drops, so no order comes in that you can't see. Orders taken on the device are saved and synced when you are back online.

[For life on the food truck]
Use it on iPhone or iPad. You can keep the screen on during trading, get a notification when an order needs approval, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

[Plan your week]
Set up your events (pitches) and pitch locations once and you can take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is an app for food truck operators and their staff. A HatchGrab account is needed to log in.
